result.quote: “Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey.”
result.reason: The key accurately paraphrases what the speakers want to learn: whether their journey will succeed. However, this window does not identify the speakers as Dan’s people or identify the priest as a Levite. Also, “Dan people” is unnatural English; “the people of Dan” or “the Danites” would be clearer if those identities were supplied by the window.
